title: SendGrid keys as Bearer credentials in an Authorization header
summary: The SendGrid key shape after Authorization: Bearer, in base62, URL-safe and trailing-dash forms.
rationale: The header name and scheme are not secret but the whole key is. Two rules (a provider format and a Bearer rule) can both match; whichever reports, it must cover the complete key.

expectation.rationale: Flagged. The value is a documented SendGrid key in a header that carries credentials; the range covers the whole key.
